NOVEMBER RENT FREE!

This elegant one bedroom one bath condo w/ private terrace is in Landing, The SF Shipyard's latest released Luxury Collection. Large windows offer natural light into the home which includes an expansive open floorplan with a modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, complete with a full complement of SS Bosch appliances including refrigerator, washer-dryer, range, dishwasher, microwave. Another huge benefit is a parking space is assigned to every home within the garage. The master developer sponsors a private shuttle service with designated stops available only for residents. Fantastic views from every window. East bay, to the SF skyline and the dazzling Bay Bridge lights. Vibrant and respectful community with walking trails and amazing neighbors. A Pocket community that may possibly be the best kept secret in all of San Francisco. PARKING INCLUDED

TERM: One year lease. Pets are considered. Tenant pays electricity and water. Owner pays garbage and gas.
